task.description: Learner receives a small ledger and a standard financial report template. Learner must: (1) classify and label the standard report components present in the template; (2) transfer and summarize all ledger entries into the correct report sections with arithmetically correct totals; and (3) review the completed report against the ledger to identify any discrepancies and state a probable cause for each.
conditions: Given a small ledger containing 8–12 entries
Using a provided standard financial report template
Learner completes the report and then reviews it for discrepancies against the original ledger

performance_levels: Below threshold: fewer than 4 of 5 elements correctly classified
At threshold: at least 4 of 5 elements correctly classified
Below threshold: one or more entries placed in wrong section
At threshold: all entries placed in correct sections
Below threshold: one or more totals incorrect
At threshold: all totals arithmetically correct
Below threshold: fewer than 2 discrepancies identified or no rationale provided
At threshold: at least 2 discrepancies identified with ledger-referenced rationale for each
Above threshold: all discrepancies identified with specific entry-level rationale

scoring.mastery_rule: Learner must reach 'At threshold' on all four rubric dimensions to demonstrate basic financial reporting capability.

assumption_notes: Integrated task design assumes a sequential structure: component classification, then report preparation, then discrepancy review; sequencing policy is not enforced by this proposal
Seeded discrepancies used in the summative task may be distinct from those used in the formative task; this is a provisional design decision requiring researcher validation
Total task time is estimated to fit within the 60-minute constraint; per-phase timing is not allocated and remains a researcher decision

prerequisites.capability: basic arithmetic with whole numbers and simple decimals (addition and subtraction)
prerequisites.rationale: Without this capability the learner cannot compute column and section totals required by obj-fr-02 success criteria ('Column and section totals are arithmetically correct') and cannot verify numerical figures when cross-referencing the ledger in obj-fr-03. Failure would occur at ev-fr-02-02 and ev-fr-sum-03 regardless of procedural knowledge; rd-fr-02-02 and rd-sum-03 would score below threshold. This capability is not demonstrated by any supplied objective and is not evidenced in the learner-state artifact.

prerequisites.capability: familiarity with the structure and purpose of a financial ledger
prerequisites.rationale: Without the ability to read and navigate a ledger the learner cannot transfer entries to the correct report sections (obj-fr-02) or cross-reference ledger figures against the completed report (obj-fr-03). Failure would occur at ev-fr-02-01, ev-fr-03-01, ev-fr-03-02, ev-fr-sum-02, and ev-fr-sum-04; entry-categorization and discrepancy-detection rubric dimensions would score below threshold independent of report-structure knowledge. This capability is not demonstrated by any supplied objective and is not evidenced in the learner-state artifact.

planning_warnings.rationale: Three instructional modules, three formative checkpoints, and one integrated summative are allocated within a 60-minute total. Per-module estimates are provisional and may be insufficient for lower-ability learners or if formative feedback cycles extend beyond planned task time. The summative module (mod-fr-sum) is allocated 10 minutes on the assumption that asmt-fr-sum can be completed within that window by a learner who has mastered all three objectives; this assumption requires researcher validation.

sequencing_rationale: mod-fr-01 precedes mod-fr-02 because obj-fr-02 carries obj-fr-01 as an explicit prerequisite: learners must be able to identify and name report sections before they can populate them from a ledger.

mod-fr-02 precedes mod-fr-03 because obj-fr-03 carries both obj-fr-01 and obj-fr-02 as explicit prerequisites: learners must be able to produce a complete report before cross-referencing it against the source ledger to identify discrepancies.

mod-fr-sum follows all three instructional modules so that the integrated summative task (asmt-fr-sum) can sample all three objective domains in a single performance after instruction and formative practice are complete.

assumption_notes: Per-module time estimates bundle instruction and formative assessment time; the per-activity split within each module is not specified and remains a researcher decision.

mod-fr-sum is a candidate module housing the summative assessment; if asmt-fr-sum is administered outside the 60-minute window the three instructional modules total 50 minutes and the scope_time_conflict warning may not apply.
All IDs in objective_ids and prerequisite_refs are drawn exclusively from the supplied allow-list; no IDs have been invented.
lesson_ids are left empty in all modules; lesson derivation is deferred to the orchestration layer as specified.

review_instructions.overview: Review the complete instructional-design proposal once before scoring. Evaluate machine validity separately from pedagogical quality.
review_instructions.scoring_scale: Use 1-5 for every dimension: 1 poor, 3 mixed/acceptable, 5 strong.
review_instructions.mandatory_question: Ignoring machine traceability or schema issues, is this instructional design pedagogically reasonable? Answer YES, PARTIALLY, or NO with a short rationale.
blinding_rules: Do not infer how the proposal was generated.
Do not assume a machine observation means the design is pedagogically poor.
Do not repair the design while scoring; record edit effort separately.
review_instructions.machine_observation_rule: Machine observations are evidence to inspect, not pedagogical verdicts. Record any reviewer disagreement separately.
